gateway_fixture.limitations: Synthetic requests with stable keys in one warm handler. Reservations and upstream are stubbed. No actual provider credits or production traffic. Counts are not whole-request CPU, latency or capacity. Cache retains at most two fixed identities and re-derives evicted/rotated keys.

verified_fixture.case: Valid moving GPS near a cell edge; no server-derived qualifying cells
verified_fixture.limitations: Excludes HTTP authentication and maintenance. Saves an empty insertion statement, not an inserted row. Nonempty qualifying sets, including revisits, retain their original insertion/conflict path. Verified scoring is optional and currently disabled in the Android build.
